rules.name: parent-lots-01-pg-child-tickets
rules.sql: SELECT 'deal_ticket_table' AS source, count(*) AS rows_total, max(d.version_timestamp) AS newest_version_at, max(d.created_timestamp) AS newest_created_at, count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.version_timestamp >= :from_date) AS rows_since_from_date FROM opera.deal_ticket_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = :bu UNION ALL SELECT 'deal_active_lots_table', count(*), max(a.updated_timestamp), max(a.created_timestamp), count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.value_date >= :from_date) FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table a WHERE a.tenant_id = :tenant AND a.business_unit = :bu UNION ALL SELECT 'valuation_date_table', count(*), max(v.updated_timestamp), max(v.created_timestamp), count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.value_date >= :from_date) FROM opera.valuation_date_table v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.business_unit = :bu

SELECT d.business_unit, d.version_created_by AS who, d.version_timestamp::date AS day, d.trade_source, d.market_action, d.deal_status, count(*) AS child_tickets, count(DISTINCT d.parent_trade_id) AS parents, min(d.version_timestamp) AS first_at, max(d.version_timestamp) AS last_at FROM opera.deal_ticket_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = :bu AND d.is_latest_version = 1 AND d.trade_id <> d.parent_trade_id AND d.version_timestamp >= :from_date GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 ORDER BY 3, 2, 8 DESC

WITH cut AS ( SELECT max(v.value_date) AS d FROM opera.valuation_date_table v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.business_unit = :bu ), kids AS ( SELECT d.parent_trade_id, d.trade_id, d.version_created_by, d.version_timestamp, d.transaction_date, d.trade_source FROM opera.deal_ticket_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = :bu AND d.is_latest_version = 1 AND d.trade_id <> d.parent_trade_id AND d.version_timestamp >= :from_date ), fam AS ( SELECT t.parent_trade_id, sum(abs(t.original_lots) * s.sign) AS family_lots, max(CASE WHEN t.trade_id = t.parent_trade_id THEN s.is_initial_trade END) AS parent_is_initial, count(*) AS family_size FROM opera.deal_ticket_table t JOIN opera.market_action_sign_mapping_table s ON s.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND s.market_action = t.market_action WHERE t.tenant_id = :tenant AND t.business_unit = :bu AND t.is_latest_version = 1 AND t.parent_trade_id IN (SELECT parent_trade_id FROM kids) GROUP BY t.parent_trade_id ), kid_agg AS ( SELECT k.parent_trade_id, count(*) AS child_tickets, min(k.version_timestamp) AS first_child_at, max(k.version_timestamp) AS last_child_at, string_agg(DISTINCT k.version_created_by, ', ') AS child_users, string_agg(DISTINCT k.trade_source, ', ') AS child_sources FROM kids k GROUP BY k.parent_trade_id ), dal AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.trade_id) a.trade_id, a.value_date, a.active_lots, a.created_by, a.created_timestamp, a.updated_by, a.updated_timestamp FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table a, cut WHERE a.tenant_id = :tenant AND a.business_unit = :bu AND a.value_date <= cut.d AND a.trade_id IN (SELECT parent_trade_id FROM kids) ORDER BY a.trade_id, a.value_date DESC ) SELECT f.parent_trade_id, f.family_size, ka.child_tickets, round((f.family_lots * coalesce(f.parent_is_initial, 1))::numeric, 6) AS expected_lots_legacy_rule, dal.active_lots AS dal_lots, dal.value_date AS dal_value_date, c.active_lots AS cloned_lots, c.deal_status AS cloned_status, CASE WHEN dal.trade_id IS NULL THEN 'NO_DAL_ROW' WHEN abs(dal.active_lots - f.family_lots * coalesce(f.parent_is_initial, 1)) < 0.000001 THEN 'MATCH' ELSE 'MISMATCH' END AS verdict, ka.first_child_at, ka.last_child_at, ka.child_users, ka.child_sources, dal.created_by AS dal_created_by, dal.created_timestamp AS dal_created_at, dal.updated_by AS dal_updated_by, dal.updated_timestamp AS dal_updated_at FROM fam f JOIN kid_agg ka ON ka.parent_trade_id = f.parent_trade_id LEFT JOIN dal ON dal.trade_id = f.parent_trade_id LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c ON c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.trade_id = f.parent_trade_id ORDER BY (CASE WHEN dal.trade_id IS NULL OR abs(dal.active_lots - f.family_lots * coalesce(f.parent_is_initial, 1)) >= 0.000001 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), ka.last_child_at DESC

SELECT d.parent_trade_id, d.trade_id, d.market_action, d.original_lots, d.lots_to_be_netted, d.deal_status, d.version_no, d.transaction_date, d.trade_source, d.version_created_by AS who, d.version_timestamp AS at, d.created_by, d.created_timestamp FROM opera.deal_ticket_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = :bu AND d.is_latest_version = 1 AND d.trade_id <> d.parent_trade_id AND d.version_timestamp >= :from_date ORDER BY d.version_timestamp DESC
